name: italia-daisy
description: CSS-only reimplementation of dev-kit-italia components as daisyUI + Tailwind recipes

scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun run docs:build && bun run storybook:build && bun run site
scripts.a11y: bun run build:css > /dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/a11y/index.ts
scripts.site: rm -rf apps/docs/dist/storybook && cp -r apps/storybook/storybook-static apps/docs/dist/storybook && echo 'Static site ready in apps/docs/dist'
